headline: Where to find Eidrolon in Palworld
title: Where to Find Eidrolon | Sunreach Flyer | Palworld Guide
video_script: Eidrolon is a dragon and dark flying Pal that lives on the Sunreach floating islands in Palworld one point zero. Wild ones roam around level sixty five, and a tougher Alpha version flies nearby at about level sixty nine. Beat the Feybreak tower to unlock travel there, or fly up with a strong flyer. Bring strong attackers and attack boosting food, or weaken it and throw a high tier sphere. Will you ride one? Comment below!
description: Palworld 1.0 Eidrolon guide: it lives on the Sunreach islands, wild ones are around level 65 and the Alpha around 69.
